data.title: bn-1u5: Rebuild RIBBIT RECOIL hop momentum and music

data.body: [P1] The relocated Golden Fly is collected by the mandatory first-checkpoint route, so it is not optional. Replaying the authored main-route inputs through cut_frog_sized_gate + hop_through_cut_gate yields x=388.22, hops=1, secrets=1, score=2550 before the refinery grapple. Move the secret/branch geometry or constrain its pickup so the normal required gate hop leaves secrets=0; add that negative assertion to the main route.

[P1] Fatal runoff/pits stop being fatal after the boss is defeated because fatal_player returns false when boss_defeated. Repro: defeat via dev_damage_boss(8), warp into runoff at (230,490), step once; state remains hp=5, deaths=0, respawn=0. This contradicts the binary-hazard contract and requested instant death. Keep post-boss projectile/contact safety if desired, but do not exempt environmental fatal hazards; add a post-boss runoff regression.

[P2] The primary A-hop instruction is nearly illegible in the captured title briefing: palette color 14 renders as low-contrast dark text against the panel, while the surrounding control lines are readable. Use a high-contrast role so the newly central A control is readable at native 192x320.

data.reason: Blocking on two reproduced gameplay regressions: the mandatory post-checkpoint hop automatically collects the supposedly optional Golden Fly (th-3otq8l), and fatal runoff/pits are ignored once boss_defeated is true (th-67gufl). Also address the low-contrast A-hop title instruction (th-zskjv3). Main/secret/effects scenarios, 9 focused tests, music lint, full just check, and WASM smoke are otherwise green.

Resolved: collect_secrets now requires a latched tongue; independent mandatory-route replay ended at x=388.219763 with secrets=0, while the controller-only optional branch replay collected exactly one Golden Fly.

Resolved: fatal_player no longer exempts boss_defeated. Independent post-boss runoff repro changed hp 5 to 0, deaths 0 to 1, respawn 0 to 60 in one frame; a subsequent frame kept deaths=1 and both camera coordinates frozen. The focused regression suite passes.
Resolved: the title A-hop instruction now renders in palette color 63. Fresh 4x capture confirms high contrast and native-scale legibility.

Final re-review approved. All three prior findings were independently reproduced as fixed: mandatory route secrets=0 and controller-only branch secrets=1; post-boss runoff immediately hp=0/deaths=1/respawn=60 with stable camera and no double death; title A-hop line is high-contrast. Main 50/1487, secret 25/615, effects 61/464 with 22 artifacts, focused 9/9, strict music lint 0 diagnostics, full just check, and packed WASM smoke all pass. Fresh title/hop/laser/branch frames inspected; the explicit laser aim is visible and its target assertion passes.
